verdict.rationale: Bolna documents all three surfaces needed for full API-driven provisioning without the dashboard: a REST API to create agents, attach numbers, and place calls (bolna-docs-14, bolna-docs-23), a native CLI for managing agents/calls/phone numbers/batches from the terminal 'no dashboard tab required' (bolna-docs-16, bolna-docs-24, bolna-probe-4), and an official MCP server connecting AI assistants/coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) directly to the account (bolna-docs-17, bolna-docs-25, bolna-probe-3). Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification that an agent end-to-end flow (create+attach number+call) works purely via MCP with no dashboard step, and no public OpenAPI spec was found (bolna-probe-2) which slightly limits programmatic discoverability.
